hook.text_role: names a shared moment of pain in the viewer's own point of view
hook.visual: first-person camera, on-screen text 'POV:' line, everyday setting

beats.visual: first-person view, the frustration plays out in real time
beats.line_role: shows the pain without explaining it

beats.visual: quick reaction close-up, deadpan stare at camera
product enters frame and fixes it, same first-person view

beats.line_role: a person's last line, not a slogan: the brief's offer, else the product plus one dry line; never 'today', never the hook again

sfx: one comedic sting on the reaction
audio.voice: no VO; on-screen text carries the story

rules: roles and patterns only - no original lines, footage, audio or likeness
